$comment: This document is INVALID ON PURPOSE. It is the fixture behind examples/examples.test.ts, which asserts that SairiOS refuses it. The `iframe` component is not in the SairiUI catalog, so the whole document is rejected and the shell renders a safe error state instead of any part of it. Note the second region is perfectly valid: a valid region does not rescue an invalid document.
title: Interface SairiOS will refuse

props.title: This will not render either
props.body: Rejection is whole-document. A partially rendered interface would let an attacker get a foothold on screen by making one region valid.
